margin_policy_reused.mev_definition: MEV = sum_dry CBE x (1 + MGA) + system margin + propellant; system margin = fraction x nominal dry mass (nominal dry = sum_dry CBE x (1 + MGA)); propellant carries no MGA and no system margin (ESA R-M1-3)
margin_policy_reused.standard: ESA SRE-PA & D-TEC staff, 'Margin philosophy for science assessment studies', SRE-PA/2011.097/, Issue 1, Revision 3, 15/06/2012 (technical note, marked 'ESA UNCLASSIFIED - For Official Use', publicly posted on sci.esa.int)
margin_policy_reused.note: mass_bom_v1 margin policy reused unchanged (not re-accessed by this lane)

h1_configuration_items.name: service-line bundle across the thrust stand

interface_planes.definition: module inlet plane: end of the common feed line (after the mixing point and the gas isolator). Fixed in the thrust-stand frame; the feed line upstream of it never moves or changes between configurations.

module outlet plane = H-1 rear inlet flange, immediately upstream of the anode/gas-distributor plane HALL_INLET_Z0 (lane 17 section 8). Everything downstream of IP-DN is H-1 and identical in every configuration.

lane 17 anode/gas-distributor plane at z = 0 (docs/architecture_comparison/hall_reference/hall_reference_v1.json injection_interface). The inlet state here is the only allowed physical difference between arms; it is a result, not a setting.

xe_subsystem.a6_text: parametric Xe ledger m_Xe_total = m_cathode + m_startup + m_transition + m_fallback + m_reserve. Cathode design term 0.10 mg/s -> 5.4 kg over 15,000 firing hours. m_startup = N_starts * t_startup * mdot_startup; m_transition = N_transitions * t_transition * mdot_transition; m_fallback = t_fallback_max * mdot_fallback; reserve is an explicit policy term, never folded into another category. The system decision is made on the complete stored-Xe subsystem m_Xe_subsystem = m_Xe + m_tank + m_regulator + m_valves + m_plumbing + m_mounting/thermal, not on propellant mass alone, against the 40 kg requirement. Startup, transition and fallback stay symbolic or scenario-based until H-1/C-1 measure them.

cg_estimate.statement: no line item has a layout position yet (no preliminary geometry, no spacecraft configuration). CG = sum(m_i r_i) / sum(m_i) once every mass-bearing line carries a position. Xe depletion moves the system CG by dr = m_Xe_used x (r_CG - r_tank) / (M - m_Xe_used); with the fixed cathode term the consumed mass is 5.4 kg, so a tank centroid offset d from the CG gives |dr| = 5.4 kg x d / (M - 5.4 kg). PROPOSED rule: Xe tank centroid on the thrust axis and as close to the spacecraft CG as the layout allows.
